units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left), seconds

camera.motion: static (empty floor/backdrop pixels identical across frames within ~1-2 grey levels)
camera.view: side view of a studio cyclorama (seamless floor curving into backdrop), seen slightly from above; no horizon, no floor markings; spotlight pool on the floor centred near (900, 950)
camera.perspective: objects walk along a line of nearly constant image y (feet at y~795-802); treat as one plane facing the camera (2D) - the rabbit is a little nearer the camera than the creature (its feet are ~5 px lower), negligible

creature.description: large fantasy quadruped (horse/antelope-like body, orange-brown with dark spots, white neck ruff, two long striped curved horns sweeping back over the body, long tail with a tufted end); walks left-to-right the whole clip
creature.reference_point: cx_mask, cy_mask = mask centroid (best proxy for the rig root/pelvis; the true root is not visible). cx_trunk = centroid of the body barrel at y 600-650 (noisier).
creature.bbox_notes: bbox spans tail tuft (left) to ear/horn tip at the head (right), horn top (y~362) to hoof bottom (y~799). Width varies with gait 496-580 px; x0 (blurred tail tuft) uncertain ~15 px.

rabbit.description: small orange-brown rabbit just ahead (right) of the creature's front hooves, facing right, hopping right at about the same pace as the creature
rabbit.bbox_notes: length nose-to-tail ~65-100 px (changes with hop stretch), height ~60-76 px including the raised ear; the ear tip and a pale translucent disc at the head are partly outside the mask

floor_backdrop.description: seamless beige studio floor / darker backdrop; no features

creature_shadow.description: soft shadow to the lower-left and right of the creature on the floor/backdrop (excluded from masks)

events.what: both animals already moving at frame 0 and still moving at frame 74 (no start/stop in clip)
rabbit hop cycle ~13 frames (0.43 s): fast phases (per-frame dx 10-12 px) near frames 7, 20, 32, 45, 58, 71; slow phases (dx 4-6 px) near frames 2, 14, 28, 38, 54, 67
rabbit body stretched / feet raised (bbox height minimum) near frames 4-6, 17-18, 30-31, 43-44, 56-57, 69-71
creature steady walk, ~7.8 px/frame centroid; no direction change; no contact between animals (creature head is above the rabbit late in the clip, gap see tracks/pair_gap.csv)

files.tracks/creature_mask.csv: per-frame mask centroid, trunk centroid, bbox, PCA extents, area
files.tracks/pair_gap.csv: per-frame centroid offset rabbit-creature and horizontal bbox gap
